authorization: Repair SQL admission and semantic retention, align feedback, rerun all methods, and update compact Fig.6/paper; cumulative DeepSeek CNY 20 including the prior study.
workload_scope: Single-period parameterized queries; three fixed metrics spanning basic aggregation, ratios/dimension filters, and multiple fact tables. This is a newly budgeted cohort, not a rerun of the entire historical five-question-form dataset.
memory_scope: ACE/AWM retain private agent A memory; G-Memory shares within the dataset run. A also performs source learning so private methods can use learned knowledge. Every question starts a new conversation.
feedback: All four planners receive the same bounded format of their own previous questions, answers, SQL, observations and binary correctness. ACE/AWM/G-Memory retain their published update algorithms; MAVRA retains native publication/maintenance. No gold SQL/value, hidden change label, or other method trace is exposed.
scenario_isolation: Each change starts from v1 data and post-heldout memory; all four memory implementations restore the same checkpoint boundary.
execution_order: Same fixed Latin-rotated arm order, two datasets per arm. Repeat 2 requires the entire first block plus remaining funds > 1.2 times first-block incremental charge + CNY 0.4, and enough time. All charges include failed attempts.
failure_policy: Retain all attempts and incurred costs. Model errors/refusals count as incorrect. An infrastructure failure or budget-interrupted cell does not become a completed full-method result; incomplete matched blocks are separately reported.
reporting: Accuracy per setting and the original four setting groups with equal setting weights; run ranges only when more than one complete repeat exists. Include all failed answers, memory costs, request usage and budget guards.

baseline_sources.awm: zorazrw/agent-workflow-memory@8c0ff8c; released prompts and online induction schedule, existing SQL tool adaptation
baseline_sources.gmemory: bingreeky/GMemory@7b581c5; unchanged official memory core and released MiniLM/retrieval/merge settings via existing service

status_before_execution: Prepared; no paid calls in this cohort.
domain_adaptation: ACE and AWM use released components through the attributed SQL adapters; G-Memory core is unchanged. Domain-specific failure wording is analytical SQL. Upstream empty transport-error replies are surfaced as adapter failures. All four methods retain common native SQL tools and metadata caches; MAVRA additionally has its native checked metric tools.

feedback_history.scope: same actor; each change restores the post-heldout checkpoint

repairs: AST-bound query-local uniqueness proofs for filtered/derived inputs and correlated EXISTS; keep base-table counterexamples
Unavailable definitions retain attributed business semantics and explicitly invalid historical mappings; execution is still denied
selection: Retain the entire previous two-schema eleven-change suite; no outcome-based scenario or repeat selection. This rerun is informed by the prior failure analysis and is not an unseen evaluation.
price_policy: Verified weekend off-peak rates; reject outside the frozen weekend window. Carry prior priced usage conservatively and original account baseline; include all new attempts.
